build_multi_nsvf_model: build a MultiNSVFModel instance that uses a multi sparse voxel encoder for neural scene rendering
build_shared_nsvf_model: build a SharedNSVFModel instance that uses a shared sparse voxel encoder for multi-view rendering
run_split_voxels: run split_voxels on a MultiNSVFModel to halve voxel size and increase max hits by 1.5x
run_reduce_stepsize: run reduce_stepsize on a MultiNSVFModel to halve the raymarching step size for finer sampling
review_multi_base_architecture: review the multi_base_architecture function that registers the multi_nsvf model with default base architecture settings
